title: What Age Can You Get a BBL? 18 Minimum, and What Else Counts
meta_description: Cleveland Clinic says you must be at least 18. No source sets an ideal age. What actually decides it: health, stable weight and enough fat.
excerpt: You must be at least 18 for a BBL, and finished developing, Cleveland Clinic says. No source we rely on names an ideal age or an upper limit. What it means under 18, from 18 to 25 and over 40 or 50, and what matters more than your age.
quick_answer:
What age can you get a BBL?

Cleveland Clinic says you must be at least 18 and should be finished developing. No source we rely on names an ideal age. Your health, a stable weight and enough fat to move matter more, and your surgeon decides at consultation.
